drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 75-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.7, creatinine 2.16-2.17, hemoglobin 13.7, platelets 260-269, sodium 139, wbc 8.4-8.6; vitals dbp 74-77, heart_rate 75-78, map 88-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 117-121, spo2 97-98, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.13-2.14, hemoglobin 13.5-13.7, platelets 268, sodium 139, wbc 8.4-8.5; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 74-79, map 90-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 119-124, spo2 97-98, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 75-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
